overview: MediCore HMS is a full-stack Hospital Management System covering all 14 operational modules — from patient registration and EMR to pharmacy, lab, billing, radiology, emergency department, and analytics. Built for 7 roles with role-based access control and a clean navy/teal medical aesthetic.
features: Role-based access for 7 roles: Admin, Doctor, Nurse, Receptionist, Pharmacist, Lab Technician, Patient
Patient registration (OPD/IPD) with full profiles, admission, discharge, and transfer workflows
Appointment scheduling with doctor calendar, OPD token queue, and real-time availability
Electronic Medical Records: SOAP notes, ICD-10 diagnoses, prescriptions, vital signs, document uploads
Laboratory: test ordering, sample tracking, result entry, critical value alerts, EMR integration
Pharmacy: prescription dispensing, drug inventory with expiry tracking, low-stock alerts, purchase orders
Ward & Bed Management: visual bed map across ICU/General/Private/Maternity/Emergency wards, real-time ER polling
Billing & Finance: OPD/IPD bill generation, insurance claims, multi-payment modes, financial dashboard
Radiology: imaging orders (X-ray/MRI/CT/Ultrasound), report upload, EMR linking
Emergency Department: ESI triage (1-5), ER bed map with 5s polling, trauma case management
Inventory & Supplies: equipment tracking, consumables, requisition system, vendor management
Reports & Analytics: Recharts dashboards covering revenue, patient demographics, bed occupancy, pharmacy sales
In-app Notifications: appointment reminders, critical lab alerts, drug expiry, low stock, shift reminders
System Administration: hospital setup, department/ward config, user management, audit logs, system settings
Pre-loaded sample data: 10 patients, 5 doctors, 3 wards, 20 drugs, 10 lab tests, 5 service types
Dark mode, responsive design, data tables with sort/filter/pagination, modal forms, loading skeletons
